email.subject: Hilarious
email.body:
Ahaha, nice, nice. A real work of art.
Ok, cool, this is more like it. How about a real challenge? Think you can tackle the Nortron mainframe? For a secutity company, I honestly expected more of them, but they do have a pretty beefy firewall going on there. It'd be a pretty huge hassle to try and take that down conventionally, so, you know, good luck with that.
Think you can break in? I dont care what you do with it if you do get in - i'll be impressed if you get admin on it at all.
If you manage it, I might have something for you.
-Naix
